Synopsis:
EIA weekly petroleum status report for the week ending August 28. U.S. crude inventories drew down sharply by 4.5 mb (vs. -1.1 mb expected), sitting at 424.5 mb. Cushing stocks edged up 80k bbls. Refinery runs and utilization increased (98% utilization). Gasoline stocks fell 1.2 mb (draw smaller than expected). Distillates rose 0.8 mb, surprising versus expectations of a 1.3 mb build. Net crude imports fell 79k bpd. Oil prices were largely unmoved — Brent ~$94.79, WTI ~$90.04. The data reflects a tight crude picture but mixed signals across the product stack.
